detail: Jianghu swordsman: adult man, broad woven straw conical hat shading half face, long rough straw rain cape, dark Chinese travelling robes and trousers, wrapped calves, cloth shoes, Japanese-style long curved katana WITH scabbard at left hip. Phase1 four poses: turn side on, lower centre of gravity, left hand grips scabbard and right hand grips hilt, katana drawn only one inch, cape hangs naturally. Phase2 four poses: blade drawn halfway, arms tense, subtle silver-white blade glow, hat rim tilts, cape corners lift backward. Phase3 four poses: katana fully drawn to shoulder side, poised for iaijutsu horizontal cut, shoulders taut, hat tipped down, cape blown back by frost wind. Release: rotate waist, fast smooth horizontal katana slash rightwards at frame5 then resheathe katana, straw cape and robe flutter strongly backward; finish with sword returned to scabbard. Weapon is a katana, NOT rapier or greatsword. Silver-white frost theme, no blue neon technological accessories.
